Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 1. Welcome

Welcome to Aarohan Technologies. This handbook summarizes the basic expectations,
conduct standards, and resources available to all employees, whether office-based
or remote.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 2. Working Hours

Standard working hours are 9:30 AM–6:30 PM IST, Monday to Friday, with flexibility
for remote employees to align with team meeting schedules.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 3. Code of Conduct

All employees are expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues respectfully,
and avoid conflicts of interest. A signed Code of Conduct Acknowledgment
(REQ-COMP-02) is required during onboarding.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 4. Confidentiality

Employees must protect confidential company and customer information at all times.
A signed NDA (REQ-COMP-03) is a mandatory onboarding requirement.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 5. Probation Period

New employees serve a 90-day probation period, during which structured 30-60-90 day
check-ins are held with their manager and People Ops partner.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 6. Grievance Process

Employees can raise concerns with their People Ops partner or through the (fictional)
internal Aarohan People Portal. All concerns are handled confidentially.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Employee Handbook (Fictional)
Section: 7. Related Policies

See also: Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy, BGV Policy, Payroll & Benefits Policy,
Remote Work Policy, Day-1/Office Policy, IT & Security Policy, and Leave Policy.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Purpose

Defines the documents every new hire must submit before or on their joining date,
and the timeline for doing so.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Standard Timeline

Pre-boarding begins immediately after offer acceptance and should conclude by the
joining date (typically a 15-day window). Documents are grouped into the categories
defined in `data/onboarding/onboarding_requirements.json`: Personal Information,
Identity Documents, Education, Current Employment, Previous Employment,
Payroll/Bank Information, PF/UAN, Benefits/Insurance, and Compliance.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Fresher vs. Experienced Hire

- **Freshers** are not required to submit Current/Previous Employment documents
  (REQ-CUR-*, REQ-PREV-*) or a UAN (REQ-PF-01), since they have no prior employment.
- **Experienced hires** must submit all Current Employment documents, and Previous
  Employment documents if they have more than one prior employer.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Escalation

If a mandatory document is not submitted within 3 business days of its due date,
the assigned People Ops partner sends a reminder. If still outstanding within
2 business days of the joining date, the case is escalated to the People Ops
Manager, and the joining date review is flagged.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Pre-boarding & Documentation Policy (Fictional)
Section: 5. Document Review Statuses

Each submitted document is tracked as one of: **Complete**, **Missing**,
**Under Review** (submitted but flagged for clarification), or **Incomplete
Information** (partially submitted, e.g. some but not all required pages/months).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Background Verification (BGV) Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Purpose

All new hires undergo background verification (BGV) before or shortly after
joining, run by our fictional third-party vendor, **TrustVerify Screening
Services**.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Background Verification (BGV) Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Scope

- **Experienced hires**: employment history verification (current and previous
  employers), education verification, and identity verification.
- **Freshers**: education verification and identity verification only.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Background Verification (BGV) Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Process

1. Employee signs the BGV Consent Form (REQ-COMP-01).
2. TrustVerify Screening Services requests supporting documents (relieving
   letters, experience certificates, payslips, education certificates).
3. TrustVerify cross-checks dates and details across documents.
4. Any discrepancy (e.g., mismatched employment dates, mismatched names across
   documents) is flagged as **Under Review** and escalated to the assigned
   People Ops partner.
5. BGV is marked **Completed** only when all checks pass with no open flags.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Background Verification (BGV) Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Discrepancy Handling

A flagged discrepancy does not automatically block employment, but it does:

- Pause final BGV sign-off until resolved.
- Get logged as a follow-up task owned by People Ops.
- Get escalated to the People Ops Manager if unresolved for more than 10
  business days after joining.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Background Verification (BGV) Policy (Fictional)
Section: 5. Payroll Interaction

If BGV is unresolved past the second payroll cycle, Finance flags the employee's
payroll file for review, but continues to run payroll unless directed otherwise
by People Ops leadership.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Payroll & Benefits Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Payroll Cycle

Salary is credited monthly, on the last working day of each month, via bank
transfer.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Payroll & Benefits Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Requirements to Set Up Payroll

Payroll cannot be configured for a new hire until:

- Bank Account Details Form (REQ-PAY-01) is submitted and verified.
- Bank Proof (REQ-PAY-02) is submitted.
- PF Nomination Form (REQ-PF-02) is submitted (all employees).
- UAN Number (REQ-PF-01) is submitted, for experienced hires with prior PF history.

If any of the above is missing by the joining date, the employee's first payroll
cycle is delayed until the following cycle.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Payroll & Benefits Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Benefits Enrollment

All employees are enrolled in the group health insurance plan through
**SecureHealth Insurance** (fictional provider) after submitting the Health
Insurance Enrollment Form (REQ-BEN-01). Dependent details (REQ-BEN-02) are
optional and can be added at any time during the year.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Payroll & Benefits Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Compensation Confidentiality

Compensation details are confidential between the employee, People Ops, and
Finance, and are not shared with managers unless required for approvals.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Remote Work Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Remote Hub Cities

Aarohan Technologies currently supports fully remote employees based in three hub
cities: Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Mumbai. These cities have no physical Aarohan
office; employees work from home or a co-working space of their choice.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Remote Work Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Onboarding Differences for Remote Hires

Remote hires complete the same document and compliance requirements as office
hires, with these differences:

- IT ships a laptop and accessories to the employee's registered address instead
  of handing it over in person.
- VPN / Remote Access Setup (REQ-IT-03) is mandatory (not required for office
  hires, who connect via the office network).
- HR Induction, Manager 1:1, and Team Introduction (REQ-DAY1-01 to 03) are held
  virtually instead of in person.
- Workstation/Desk Setup (REQ-DAY1-04) does not apply.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Remote Work Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Equipment

Remote employees are responsible for a stable internet connection. Aarohan
provides a laptop, headset, and a one-time home-office setup allowance
(amount defined separately by Finance, not detailed in this fictional dataset).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Remote Work Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Working Hours & Availability

Remote employees are expected to be reachable during core hours (11:00 AM–4:00 PM
IST) for team collaboration, with flexibility outside that window.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Day-1 / Office Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Office Location

Aarohan Technologies' only physical office is at the Pune Headquarters. Employees
based there are expected onsite on Day 1 and follow the standard office schedule
thereafter (hybrid flexibility is decided team-by-team, not detailed in this
fictional dataset).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Day-1 / Office Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Day-1 Schedule (Office-Based Hires)

1. Check-in with People Ops, ID badge issuance.
2. Workstation / Desk Setup (REQ-DAY1-04).
3. HR Induction session (REQ-DAY1-01).
4. Manager 1:1 (REQ-DAY1-02).
5. Team Introduction (REQ-DAY1-03).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Day-1 / Office Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Day-1 Schedule (Remote Hires)

Remote hires follow the same four sessions (HR Induction, Manager 1:1, Team
Introduction, plus an IT setup call) held virtually — see the Remote Work Policy
for details. Desk setup does not apply.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Day-1 / Office Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Rescheduling

If a new hire's Day 1 falls on a company holiday or the assigned People Ops
partner is unavailable, HR reschedules the induction session within 2 business
days and notifies the employee's manager.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — IT & Security Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Asset Provisioning

Every new hire is issued a company laptop (REQ-IT-01) and company email plus core
system access (REQ-IT-02) before or on Day 1. Office-based hires receive their
laptop in person; remote hires receive it by courier (see Remote Work Policy).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — IT & Security Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Access Control

System access follows least-privilege by default: employees receive access only
to the systems required for their role, expanded on request with manager approval.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — IT & Security Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. VPN & Remote Access

Remote employees must complete VPN / Remote Access Setup (REQ-IT-03) before
accessing internal systems. Office employees connect via the office network and
do not require VPN setup for standard access.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — IT & Security Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Acceptable Use

Company laptops and accounts are for business use. Employees must not share
credentials, install unauthorized software, or store confidential company data on
personal devices.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — IT & Security Policy (Fictional)
Section: 5. Offboarding Note

(Out of scope for this onboarding-focused dataset — included here only for
completeness of the fictional policy set.) Asset return and access revocation are
handled by IT within 1 business day of an employee's last working day.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Leave Policy (Fictional)
Section: 1. Leave Types

- **Casual Leave**: 12 days/year, for short personal needs.
- **Sick Leave**: 10 days/year, for illness or medical appointments.
- **Earned/Privilege Leave**: 15 days/year, accrued monthly, for planned time off.
- **Public Holidays**: as per the Aarohan holiday calendar (not detailed in this
  fictional dataset).

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Leave Policy (Fictional)
Section: 2. Accrual During Onboarding

New hires start accruing Earned Leave from their joining date and can use Casual
or Sick Leave from Day 1, subject to manager approval.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Leave Policy (Fictional)
Section: 3. Applying for Leave

Leave requests are submitted through the (fictional) internal Aarohan People
Portal and require manager approval. Sick leave of 3+ consecutive days requires a
medical note.

Aarohan Technologies — Aarohan Technologies — Leave Policy (Fictional)
Section: 4. Leave During Probation

New hires may take leave during their 90-day probation period, but are encouraged
to coordinate with their manager to minimize disruption to early onboarding
milestones (30-60-90 day check-ins).
